human_scale_assumption: Pearson and MAE treat the 1-5 ratings as equally spaced; Spearman uses only their ordering. Public DefSim provides aggregate ratings, so this benchmark does not estimate annotator uncertainty.

metric_families.no_defsim_label_fit: No DefSim human labels are used to fit these scores. The neural models themselves are pretrained.
metric_families.defsim_calibrated_oof: Affine transformations are fitted on DefSim training folds and evaluated only on paper-disjoint held-out folds. These are exploratory DefSim-trained metrics, not zero-shot metrics.

calibration.assignment: Paper-connected components assigned without human ratings; no paper occurs in both train and test within a fold.

SciDef_NLI.method: five-fold paper-disjoint out-of-fold clipped affine calibration

nli.definition: Arithmetic mean of entailment(left, right) and entailment(right, left), as used by SciDef.

unseen_paper_evaluation.method: Five paper-disjoint folds. Raw metrics use no DefSim labels. Every calibrated score for a row is fitted only on the other folds. Pooled statistics concatenate the five unseen-fold predictions; fold distributions show small-sample variability.

retrospective_40_train_20_test.warning: This is an illustrative 40-row train / 20-row test split using outer fold 0. It is paper-disjoint, and all calibrated scores on its test rows use only its training rows. It is not a pristine holdout because the formula family was previously inspected on all DefSim rows.

unseen_paper_evaluation.selection_caveat: Out-of-fold calibration prevents paper leakage but does not undo the fact that M1-M5 and the choice of M3 were developed after viewing DefSim. Only a new frozen human-rated dataset can provide a clean final confirmation of metric selection.

limitations: Pearson and MAE assume the five rating categories are equally spaced; Spearman does not.
Only aggregate human ratings are available here, so annotator-level uncertainty is not estimated.
Raw metrics and DefSim-calibrated metrics are separate experimental families and must not be presented as equally label-free.
Out-of-fold calibration prevents row and paper leakage, but metric selection on the same 60 pairs remains exploratory until evaluated on new frozen human judgments.
DefSim pairs include outputs from extractors selected using NLI, which may favor the SciDef NLI metric.
All canonical exact-term matches are GT-prediction pairs; no GT-GT or prediction-prediction pair passes the gate.
Therefore DefSim evaluates definition similarity, not general concept-identity matching.
Timing is local CPU wall time and should be compared only within this run.
